title: Bad nginx deploy
reason: Location matches (nginx/web), but the described problem (timeout due to config change) differs from the actual regression causing 500 errors; the trigger (new nginx deploy) is correctly identified.
option_titles: Rollback web container to previous nginx image
root_cause: The nginx security update (image nginx:1.28) deployed at 22:54:16 changed the reverse-proxy configuration, causing nginx to time out when connecting to the API container, which results in 500 errors for users.
truth: The new nginx version 1.28 introduced a regression that causes it to return 500 Internal Server Error for all requests.
